ok-seb-2026-general-list.title: NOVEMBER / 2026 List of Elections (November 3, 2026 General Election), county by county: state officers, legislative officers and judicial officers
ok-seb-2026-general-list.note: Read for all 77 counties (from the federal loader's cached copy); every county's list of each race agreed. Names, parties and offices only. The list's order is kept as the ballot order (for partisan offices the Board's drawing: Republican, Democrat, Libertarian, then independents; for judges the list's own order). Names are printed in capitals and shown in ordinary capitals (a sitting member as the roster spells the name). The list carries 9 judicial retention questions without the judges' names; they are not loaded.

ok-seb-2026-candidate-list-book.title: Candidates for Office 2026, filed April 1-3, 2026 (2026 Candidate List Book, compiled as of 5:00 p.m. April 3, 2026): state officers, State Senator, State Representative, District Judge and Associate District Judge
ok-seb-2026-candidate-list-book.note: Read from the federal loader's cached copy: the filing number and name columns only, by character position; the city column beside each name is never read. Who filed for each seat and who was on each party's June 16 primary ballot (less withdrawals and strikes). A seat with one candidate left is stored with that candidate marked unopposed; a seat only one party filed for was settled in its primary. Votes not loaded: the June 16 primary and August 25 runoff results are published only on the Board's results site (https://results.okelections.us/OKER/?elecDate=20260616), which refuses scripts (403 Forbidden).

ok-seb-2026-withdrawals.title: 2026 Candidate Withdrawals
ok-seb-2026-withdrawals.note: State-office withdrawals matched to the book by filing number: 3 before the June 16 primary (left off its ballot), 1 after it (kept in the primary field, with a note). Columns kept: Number, Name, Office, Date.

ok-seb-2026-contests.title: 2026 Contests of Candidacy
ok-seb-2026-contests.note: Rulings read: 2026-01 (2026-OK-SH97): withdrawn; 2026-02 (2026-OK-SH34): stricken; 2026-03 (2026-OK-SPI): retained; 2026-04 (2026-OK-SH24): withdrawn; 2026-05 (2026-OK-SH83): withdrawn. A candidate stricken from the ballot is left off the primary.

ok-openstates-roster.title: Oklahoma legislators and statewide officials
ok-openstates-roster.note: Today's holder of each seat and office. The roster carries the Governor, Lieutenant Governor and Attorney General only among statewide offices. A candidate is marked as the sitting member only when the name fits the holder of that seat and no other candidate in the race fits.

ok-census-cb-2024-county.title: Cartographic boundary file, counties, 2024, 1:500,000 (cb_2024_us_county_500k)
ok-census-cb-2024-county.note: Oklahoma's 77 counties: names and GEOIDs only; a race's county_ids are the counties the book names for its district.

ok-seb-2026-general-list-local.title: NOVEMBER / 2026 List of Elections (November 3, 2026 General Election), county by county: county officers, city and town officers and fire protection district boards
ok-seb-2026-general-list-local.note: Read for all 77 counties (from the federal loader's cached copy): under each county, the county offices in the list's legislative, district and county section and every city, town and fire district section. 97 candidate lines in 45 printed contests gave 88 candidates in 41 contests (council 10, county assessor 4, county commissioner 19, county treasurer 3, fire board 3, mayor 1, sheriff 1); 4 contests are printed under more than one county, and every county's copy agreed. Read: the section, the office and the candidate line (a name, and a party on county offices); the page has no contact columns. Names are printed in capitals and shown in ordinary capitals. County offices carry the ballot order: parties in the order of the Board's drawing, then independents, as 26 O.S. 6-106 sets it and the list follows. For city, town and fire district offices the list does not say that its order is the ballot's, so none is given. Only contested races are printed. Not loaded: 34 local propositions and questions. The SHA-256 is of the page's bytes as fetched.

ok-census-2020-place.title: 2020 place codes, Oklahoma (st40_ok_place2020.txt)
ok-census-2020-place.note: Names and FIPS place codes of Oklahoma's incorporated cities and towns, and the counties each lies in. A city or town on the Board's November list is matched by its name and kind word to exactly one entry and named as the Bureau writes it; 6 are used. Read: name, code, type and counties; the file has no contact columns and is kept whole.

local_calendar.t: On November 3, 2026 every Oklahoma county elects a county assessor, a county treasurer and the county commissioners for Districts 1 and 3, by party; the county clerk, court clerk, sheriff and District 2 commissioner are elected in 2028. Fire protection districts elect board members each November, without parties, and Bartlesville, Clinton, El Reno, Lawton, Tulsa and Yukon have city contests on this ballot. Most other cities and towns elect in April of odd-numbered years (a city with its own charter may choose another date), and school boards were elected on February 10 and April 7, 2026.
local_calendar.s: 19 O.S. 131 (county officers) and 901.5 (fire protection districts); 11 O.S. 16-102 and 16-103 (cities and towns); Oklahoma State Election Board, 2026 Voter Information Calendar (school board election dates)

local_coverage.t: From the State Election Board's November 3 list, read county by county for all 77 counties: every contest it prints for a county office, a city or town office or a fire protection district board (41 contests, 88 candidates, in 28 counties). Oklahoma prints only contested races: an office with one candidate left, or one settled in the June 16 primary or the August 25 runoff, is not on the ballot and is not shown; that is why no district attorney appears (of the 27 offices, 23 had one candidate when filing closed and 4 had candidates of one party only). Not loaded: the 34 local propositions and questions on the list.
local_coverage.s: Oklahoma State Election Board, NOVEMBER / 2026 List of Elections, and Candidates for Office 2026 (who filed for district attorney); 26 O.S. 6-102 (an unopposed candidate is not printed on the ballot)

gaps.w: county officers elected without a November contest
gaps.r: Oklahoma leaves an office off the ballot when one candidate is left or a primary or runoff settled it, so those county officers are not on the State Election Board's November list. Who filed and who won is published on the Board's filing portal and results site, which refuse scripts, so they are not shown here.
